Whether to show a visual valid indicator (e.g. Bootstrap is-valid style) when the field has no errors.
Defaults to false.

syncSources.description: Declares source fields for one-way additive sync.

class.description:
The class name as a string.

Uses typescript discriminated unions to help enforce types.
Ref: https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/2/narrowing.html#discriminated-unions

config.description: The configuration specific to the class of this form field.

value.description:
The current value of this model.

The 'value' is only available after the form config has been processed,
and the default values or the existing record values have been populated.

defaultValue.description:
The default value for this model.

The server-side processing uses this as the default for the field.
Defaults from ancestor fields will be combined to form the default value for a new record.

newEntryValue.description:
The value to use when creating new entries in the repeatable.

Only available in a repeatable's elementTemplate in 'model.config.newEntryValue'.

The default value for a repeatable is specified in 'model.config.defaultValue'.
The value for a repeatable is in 'model.config.value'.

validators.description: The validators that are configured at the field level that look at only this model.

wrapperCssClasses.description: The optional css classes to be applied to the wrapper element.

editCssClasses.description: The optional css classes to be applied to the form dom node in edit mode.

disabled.description:
Whether the form control should be disabled.

Disabled controls are excluded from the parent form's value.

Note that disabled here affects only the model's disabled state.
Components can be disabled or not and readonly or not, independent of this property.
Some components must link the component and model disabled state due to angular FormControl requirements.
